rawFailuresBeforeCertification.cause: the drive sent the key while the click was still being handled; ss5 alone passed 70/70 on the same build. Second observation of an input landing without effect (first: ss7 under load, 2026-10-06 g45). Fixed in the drive by asserting the click's effect before the next key (98127b7); the quiet batch then passed.

rawFailuresBeforeCertification.detail: 'Ctrl+Z undoes the knob drag': the probe's lastAction was timeline.zoom.selection — the Ctrl+Z arrived as a bare Z
rawFailuresBeforeCertification.cause: understood: JUCE reads a modifier's physical state when it handles the key; the drive released Ctrl 40 ms after the key while the app was still finishing the knob drag's engine rebuild. The same cause fits the ss5 Ctrl+K above and the ss7-under-load observation. Fixed in the drive (03763dc: a chord waits for the app to be idle, then holds the modifier 80 ms); the product side (a fast Ctrl+Z during a busy moment could read as Z) is a separate task.
